client_event_id.description: Opaque stable identifier; max 128 UTF-8 bytes, no raw session ID or path

provider.description: Host must additionally enforce nonblank valid UTF-8, no Unicode control characters and maximum 128 UTF-8 bytes

model.description: Host must additionally enforce nonblank valid UTF-8, no Unicode control characters and maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes

cost_total.description: Finite USD API-equivalent estimate, not subscription billing; generous per-call ceiling prevents floating-point aggregate overflow

stop_reason.description: Extensible, not an enum; host additionally enforces nonblank valid UTF-8, no Unicode control characters and maximum 32 UTF-8 bytes

omp_version.description: Host must additionally enforce nonblank valid UTF-8, no Unicode control characters and maximum 64 UTF-8 bytes

occurred_at.description: UTC RFC3339; at most five minutes ahead of server time, no past retention cutoff

timing.description: Finite milliseconds; absent/null means not measured
